deploy-bot: Deploy trigger: staged rollout v2.8.1 -> canary 5% in eu-west. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rollout id 78321. Starting at 1769504321.
Priya R.: Noted. I'm on call for the window. Can we confirm we're using pinned model v2.8.1-rc3? :eyes:
Carlos M.: Yes pinned to cpu/gpu pool image rfi-2026-01, no hotfix applied. infra health: all nodes green.
Jae Kim: Telemetry booting. I'll watch latencies and 5xx. Set alert threshold to 2x baseline for tail latency.
Marta L.: Running smoke tests against canary sample. Will report failures in 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout progressed to 5% (12 hosts). Observability links: https://dash.re/redwood/rollouts/78321
Sam O.: Quick note — release notes pushed to docs: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.8.1. No schema changes.
Marta L.: smoke: 3/65 tests failed (flaky tokenizer edge-case). Failing requests are for `embed_api` with long prompts.
Jae Kim: Seeing slight increase in p95 for embed_api in eu-west from 120ms -> 210ms. Error rate steady. I'm digging into traces.
Priya R.: Hold for decision. Marta, can you repro locally with same seed? If flaky, we might pin canary to 0% and investigate.
Marta L.: repros locally with seed42. Looks related to kv-cache prime on first request. Working on a narrow patch.
Carlos M.: Infra note: if we stop canary, we can pin traffic away via route-rule `rollout/78321:set=off` — takes ~30s to propagate.
Priya R.: Vote time. Options: 1) Stop (pause) rollout and pin to previous stable v2.8.0; 2) Let canary run while Marta qualifies a quick fix; 3) Rollback immediately.
Jae Kim: My vote: pause. p95 increase is concerning but not catastrophic; keeps rollback option quick. :+1:
Sam O.: Agree with pause. We should avoid noisy rollback unless user-facing errors increase.
Marta L.: I can push a narrow patch (kv-cache delay fix) in ~25m. If paused, I can test on canary hosts.
Priya R.: Consensus = pause. @deploy-bot, pause rollout 78321. Pin traffic back to v2.8.0 for canary group.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing staged rollout 78321. Traffic re-routed to stable v2.8.0 for canary group. Rollback not initiated. 
Priya R.: I'll open a follow-up thread for the patch verification. Thanks team. :heart:
Jae Kim: I'll keep monitoring and will escalate if error rate rises. Timeline: unpause decision after Marta's verification or 40m timeout.
Marta L.: Will update in thread with test matrix and pass/fail. Starting local fix now.
